description: This file defines a React-like component called 'Home' using the LightningJS framework. It manages the state and UI for a note management system, including loading, displaying, creating, updating, and deleting notes. The component composes other components such as Header, NotesList, and NoteEditor, and interacts with utility functions for persistent storage.

methods.name: $onSelect
methods.description: Handles selection of a note by updating the selectedId state.

methods.name: $onCreate
methods.description: Creates a new note, updates the notes list, saves to storage, and sets the new note as selected.

methods.name: $onChange
methods.description: Updates an existing note, saves changes, and updates the selected note.

methods.name: $onDelete
methods.description: Deletes a note after confirmation, updates the notes list, saves to storage, and updates the selected note.
